nodes.author: BagaiDr
nodes.text: only 2 genes for which aa identity was lower than nt identity were SH and G. These genes were divergent within and between groups. In addition to AA changes, another contributor to this divergence was variable length of G and SH genes. Mutations in SH occur during cell culture; sequence truncations arose during passage, function of SH is not known; SH-deleted viruses are minimally attenuated in non-human primates but replication competent in cells & rodents. ability of virus to tolerate such variation in SH during culture is unexplained, biological effect is unknown. HMPV G exhibited substantial AA diversity, greater than nucleotide variability- selective pressure. HMPV G induces binding but not nAbs, does not provide protection in animal. interaction between HMPV G and RIG-I not confirmed; source of selective pressure, if such exists, biological reason for diversity of G and SH is unknown.
